notes: Batch 1 (40 species), prepared by the coding agent on 2026-11-21 at the owner's request, for a portfolio project. Sources read that day: GBIF Backbone Taxonomy (CC BY 4.0) and GBIF species profiles (WoRMS flags) via the GBIF API; Wikidata (CC0) for the IUCN category, cited second-hand with the IUCN edition its statement references; English Wikipedia (revision ids recorded) for population figures, cited second-hand. IUCN pages were not read (robots.txt disallows this agent). Images from Wikimedia Commons: licence read from Commons metadata and compared with the file's embedded copyright fields; files without a named creator were not used. Trend is 'unknown' throughout (not stated by Wikidata). Countries and regions are not set.

editorial.overview: The giant panda (Ailuropoda melanoleuca) is a mammal of the family Ursidae, in the order Carnivora. It is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List (2022.2 edition), as recorded on Wikidata.

populationEstimates.method: Wild pandas older than 1.5 years, excluding dependent young (Fourth National Survey, China, 2011–2014, published 2015)

editorial.overview: The tiger (Panthera tigris) is a mammal of the family Felidae, in the order Carnivora. It is listed as Endangered on the IUCN Red List (2022.2 edition), as recorded on Wikidata.

population.note: We have not yet checked a published population estimate for this profile.

editorial.overview: The african bush elephant (Loxodonta africana) is a mammal of the family Elephantidae, in the order Proboscidea. It is listed as Endangered on the IUCN Red List (2022.2 edition), as recorded on Wikidata.

population.note: We have not yet checked a published population estimate for this profile.

editorial.overview: The eastern gorilla (Gorilla beringei) is a mammal of the family Hominidae, in the order Primates. It is listed as Critically endangered on the IUCN Red List (2022.2 edition), as recorded on Wikidata.
